producer_order.per_family_action_ids_per_position: exactly one of each action ID in every candidate position across the four tasks
producer_order.primary_gold_position_balance: exactly one gold action in each position across the four action tasks
producer_order.passing_candidate_position_balance: among schedules satisfying ID and gold balance, minimize passing-candidate count spread across positions; every position must contain both passing and failing cases in action families
producer_order.schedule: seeded four-row Latin schedule built by deterministic backtracking under exact position-balance constraints
producer_order.abstention_family_schedule: first seeded base permutation; no gold action exists

donors.truth_channel_swap: nonself donor from the same pair_id; prefer a donor differing on the swapped channel while minimizing off-channel differences; otherwise use the next nonself pair member as a preregistered sham
donors.candidate_coordinate: next nonself same-pair task; transfer role-to-position schedule and map to recipient action IDs

diagnostic_test_overlay.allowed_change: generic assertion message to field-specific assert_eq diagnostics

nuisance_predictor_audit.gate: no action ID or candidate position is a perfect correctness indicator within an action family
